notes.content:

On every Tuesday and Friday, GM will create a PVP room in PVP channel Free 1. Around 10 AM ~ 12PM (GMT+9). we will inform you when the room is ready in game notice..

The reward for this week is Rider Egg !!!!! (2 for winners and 1 for losers)

● Event ends 

● New Event  
   - New Event Arcade "Temple of Monkey King" 
    *Available in the event period only
    *Needs Normal Arcade Ticket 1 to enter.
    *Clear rewards: Monkey King Costumes. 
    *April 6th ~ next update.

● New Item  
    - Golden Egg I, II will be renewed to 14 Egg series. 
    - Warrior, Samurai, Gatchaman, Dark Avenger, Forest Keeper, Shinobi, Blaze, Magician, Monkey King, Death Scythe, Paladin, Rider, Gold Firer, Saw Blade Eggs. 
    - Only Unlimited costumes of Unique/Rare grade will be obtained from these eggs.
    - Previous Gold Firer Egg will not be available anymore.

● New Item 
    - Limited period sales of 4 new packages. (50%~80% discounted price) 
    - Only 1 time purchasable per 1 character. 
    - Each packages contains , and you can exchange them with valuable items. 

● Sale ends  
    - Syringe Extra Large, Syringe Large are no longer available in cash shop. 

● Tower Mode Revampment
    - Map graphic design and the rules will be changed. 
      * Background of map and the look of Tower 
      *  will be separated into Main Tower and Sub Tower. 
      * The team who destroy the opposite team's tower will be the winner. 
      * To reach the main tower, you have to destroy 2 of Sub-towers first. 
      * Sub tower attacks the approaching enemies. 
      * If no one manage to destroy the main tower, the team who damaged the tower more will win. 

● New Ladder Season 2
     - Ladder, Arcade rank will be reset after end of Season 1 and the rewards will be given by ranks. 
      * Please refer the announcement about New Ladder season. 

● Others
     - Some of costumes' price will be slightly down. 
     - Opening "My shop" will be possible at level 30. 
     - "1:1 Trade" is available at level 30.
     - (Bug fix) Clone costume: Legendary costumes will be available for Clone Costume system.

notes.title: PVP with GMs!! (17th week)
notes.content:
Greeting Fighters!!!

Let's prepare for the matches with GMs!!!!

On every Friday, GM will create a PVP room in PVP channel Free 1. Around 10 AM and 5 PM (GMT+9). we will inform you when the room is ready in game notice..
The room's password is secret and players have to guess. If there is not enough player can figure out password, GM will give a hint.
The match is team death match. Their is no rematch, only 1 match to decide win/lose.
There will be 10 matches: 5 at the morning and 5 at the afternoon . GM will exit the room after each match.
Rewards will be announced at Wednesday and will be delivered at next Monday via in-game shared account mail. Every rewards are non-tradeable.
One account only can receive reward 1 time. If you already participated in this event, please let others have chance to win GMs.

The reward for this week is Golden Egg II !!!!! (3 for winners and 1 for losers)

Zone4 team

notes.content:

Event Closing - Valentine's Day Event 
  - 'Valentine Key' item sale was finished. 
  - Removed drop items from Valentine's day event
  - Removed Chocolate, Candy item from DB

  - Every Arcades' EXP, Zen amount increases to +100%
   * Except , 
  - Free Arcade Tickets!
   * At 00:00 AM everyday, all players will get Normal Arcade Ticket(5), and Hard Arcade Ticket(1) via Shared account mail. 
   * After the event period, all free tickets in mail box will be removed. 
  - 50% Discount sale on Arcade Ticket

Tower Mode time schedule changed.  
  - Tower Mode will be opening every 30 minutes during Weekdays, weekends. 

[Cash Items] 

 New Costume - Bear & Bunny Costume Set  
  - 6 Parts (Hair, Face, Shirts, Pants, Gloves, Shoes) on Shop.  
  - Decoration parts ( Back, Hat, Ring) were added on Lucky Egg.
  -  3 Sets: Zen +10%
     6 Sets: Zen +20%
     9 Sets: Zen +30%
  - Price:  1 Day - 10 Cash
           7 Days - 35 Cash
       Permanent - 530 Cash

New Packages  
  - Limited sale!  Meet our 4 new package at 50%~80% discounted price during the event period! 
    * Only 1 time purchasable per 1 character. 
    * Each packages contains , which is able to exchange with valuable items.

New Drills  
  - Check our 3 new drills out that specialized for different rewards!  
  
Lucky Egg Rate change   
  - The chance to obtain Costumes from every Lucky Eggs was increased drastically. 

[New Contents]  

Clone Costume system 
 - You can now change your costume's look.
 - Clone Costume Conversion is available at Dr.K in Zone6
 - Please check this  Guide  about new system. 
 
Bug Fix     
Rare Gold Firer Full costume bug 
 - Graphic glitch of Joony character was fixed.

Chicken Mask bug  
 - Graphic glitch of Lilru character was fixed.

Hapkido skill  bug  
 - Bug of hitting with Storm Combo skill was fixed. 

Special Costume Box (Hair Up)  
 - Costume's name changed from "Hair UP" to "Hair Hat".

Others 
 - Skill box will drop in high chance from defeating Arcade Bosses.
 - Price changed for some of costumes in shop. (Adventure, Rocker, Inventor, Pierrot, CowBoy&Girl, General, Hunter of every rarity)

notes.content:

2017, February 9th

● Event Close 
  - Contents regarding to previous events was removed.

   1. Login Event

      Also players can obtain Valentine Boxes in certain chance from every Arcades except Park Arcade.

        →  A Valentine Box contains special items that you cannot usually get.  To open the box, you need a Valentine Key that you can buy from Cash Shop with 250 Cash.

    Super Mega Phones (2, 3, 5) 
    ORB Box +2 ~ +5 (1, 2, 3)
    ORB Box +5 ~ +10 (1, 2, 3)

     3 sets: Exp gain + 10%
     6 sets: Exp gain + 20%
